Only the read-only subcommands are shown. `add`, `add-smiles`, `edit` and `remove` write to
`frogchem/substituter/data` inside the installed package, and no option points them at a scratch copy.
Running them here would change the library of every user of this installation.

**1. Scope presets** for `frog-substitute --scope`.

```bash
frog-sub-db scopes
```

```text
                                                                                   Scope Presets
╭─────────────┬───────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Scope       │ Count │ Fragments                                                                                                                                                  │
├─────────────┼───────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ halogens    │     4 │ fluoro, chloro, bromo, iodo                                                                                                                                │
│ alkyls      │    12 │ methyl, ethyl, n-propyl, isopropyl, cyclopropyl, n-butyl, isobutyl, sec-butyl, tert-butyl, cyclohexyl, cyclopentyl, adamantyl                              │
│ haloalkyls  │     3 │ trifluoromethyl, difluoromethyl, trichloromethyl                                                                                                           │
│ aryls       │    17 │ phenyl, p-tolyl, o-tolyl, m-tolyl, xylyl, mesityl, Dipp, p-anisyl, p-fluorophenyl, p-chlorophenyl, p-bromophenyl, p-CF3-Ph, p-cyanophenyl, p-nitrophenyl,  │
│             │       │ 3,5-bis(CF3)phenyl, 1-naphthyl, 2-naphthyl                                                                                                                 │
│ heteroaryls │     5 │ 2-pyridyl, 3-pyridyl, 4-pyridyl, 2-thienyl, 2-furyl                                                                                                        │
│ oxygen      │     7 │ hydroxy, methoxy, ethoxy, isopropoxy, tert-butoxy, trifluoromethoxy, phenoxy                                                                               │
│ sulfur      │     2 │ mercapto, thiomethyl                                                                                                                                       │
│ nitrogen    │     5 │ amino, dimethylamino, diethylamino, nitro, acetylamino                                                                                                     │
│ carbonyl    │     5 │ formyl, acetyl, carboxy, methoxycarbonyl, cyano                                                                                                            │
│ phosphines  │     5 │ PPh2, PtBu2, PCy2, PMe2, PEt2                                                                                                                              │
│ ligands     │     9 │ PPh2, PtBu2, PCy2, PMe2, PEt2, 2-pyridyl, TMS, TIPS, Bpin                                                                                                  │
│ edg         │    10 │ methyl, ethyl, isopropyl, tert-butyl, methoxy, hydroxy, dimethylamino, diethylamino, p-tolyl, p-anisyl                                                     │
│ ewg         │    14 │ fluoro, chloro, bromo, trifluoromethyl, nitro, cyano, formyl, acetyl, carboxy, methoxycarbonyl, p-CF3-Ph, p-nitrophenyl, p-cyanophenyl, 3,5-bis(CF3)phenyl │
│ steric      │    13 │ methyl, isopropyl, tert-butyl, cyclohexyl, adamantyl, xylyl, mesityl, Dipp, 3,5-bis(CF3)phenyl, PPh2, PtBu2, PCy2, TIPS                                    │
╰─────────────┴───────┴────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

* There are 14 presets. A fragment can belong to several of them, e.g. `PPh2` is in `phosphines`, `ligands`
  and `steric`.
* The presets are fixed lists in the code. `--scope` also accepts a category, a tag, `all`, or a
  comma-separated list of names.

**2. Fragments of one category** (`--category`; use `--tag` to filter by tag).

```bash
frog-sub-db list --category aryls
```

```text
                                                 Fragment Database (17 fragments)
╭────────────────────┬──────────┬────────┬────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Name               │ Category │ Delete │ Attach │ Tags                                   │ Description                          │
├────────────────────┼──────────┼────────┼────────┼────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤
│ phenyl             │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, aromatic                         │ Phenyl group (-Ph)                   │
│ p-tolyl            │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, edg, para                        │ p-Tolyl group (-4-Me-Ph)             │
│ o-tolyl            │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, ortho, bulky                     │ o-Tolyl group (-2-Me-Ph)             │
│ m-tolyl            │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, meta                             │ m-Tolyl group (-3-Me-Ph)             │
│ xylyl              │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, ortho, bulky, 2,6-disubstituted  │ 2,6-Xylyl group (-2,6-Me2-Ph)        │
│ mesityl            │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, bulky                            │ Mesityl group (-2,4,6-Me3-Ph)        │
│ Dipp               │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, bulky, ligand, 2,6-disubstituted │ 2,6-Diisopropylphenyl group (-Dipp)  │
│ p-anisyl           │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, edg, para                        │ p-Anisyl group (-4-OMe-Ph)           │
│ p-fluorophenyl     │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, para, fluorinated                │ 4-Fluorophenyl group (-4-F-Ph)       │
│ p-chlorophenyl     │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, para                             │ 4-Chlorophenyl group (-4-Cl-Ph)      │
│ p-bromophenyl      │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, para                             │ 4-Bromophenyl group (-4-Br-Ph)       │
│ p-CF3-Ph           │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, ewg, para, fluorinated           │ 4-Trifluoromethylphenyl group        │
│ p-cyanophenyl      │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, ewg, para                        │ 4-Cyanophenyl group (-4-CN-Ph)       │
│ p-nitrophenyl      │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, ewg, para                        │ 4-Nitrophenyl group (-4-NO2-Ph)      │
│ 3,5-bis(CF3)phenyl │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, ewg, bulky, fluorinated          │ 3,5-Bis(trifluoromethyl)phenyl (ArF) │
│ 1-naphthyl         │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl, bulky                            │ 1-Naphthyl group                     │
│ 2-naphthyl         │ aryls    │      0 │      1 │ aryl                                   │ 2-Naphthyl group                     │
╰────────────────────┴──────────┴────────┴────────┴────────────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────╯
```

* All 17 aryls have Delete 0 and Attach 1. They were generated from SMILES that start with `*`, so atom 0 is
  the H that replaced the `*`, and atom 1 is the ipso carbon that bonds to the molecule.
* The names in the first column are the ones to pass to `frog-substitute --db-frag` / `--db-frags`.

**3. Machine-readable list.** Global options go before the subcommand.

```bash
frog-sub-db -q --format csv list --tag halogen
```

```text
# Fragment Database (4 fragments)
Name,Category,Delete,Attach,Tags,Description
fluoro,halogens,0,1,"halogen, ewg",Fluoro group (-F)
chloro,halogens,0,1,"halogen, ewg",Chloro group (-Cl)
bromo,halogens,0,1,"halogen, ewg",Bromo group (-Br)
iodo,halogens,0,1,halogen,Iodo group (-I)
```

`--tag halogen` matches 4 fragments. `iodo` carries only the `halogen` tag, while the other three are also
tagged `ewg`. `--format csv` writes the table title as a `#` comment line.
